name: EFL Legacy System

rewards.name: +$25 FAAB
rewards.note: The commissioner adds $25 in Free Agent Acquisition Budget to the owner's Sleeper waiver budget for the eligible league season.

rewards.name: Supplemental Dynasty Rookie Pick
rewards.note: One additional Dynasty rookie draft pick awarded after the normal rookie draft and before waivers/free agency open. The exact supplemental draft slot is set by league rule.

rewards.name: Free EFL Dynasty Entry
rewards.note: One future EFL Dynasty season entry paid in full. This is the top Legacy reward and is designed to require multiple seasons of saving.

rules: The EFL Legacy System officially begins with the 2026 season.
Normal performance badges and Legacy Points are earned only from achievements completed during the 2026 season and later.
Pre-2026 history is recognized only through designated Heritage badges and does not recreate every historical weekly achievement.
Lifetime Legacy Points never decrease and determine a franchise's permanent Legacy Rank.
For every 10 Legacy Points earned, a franchise also earns 1 spendable EFL Credit.
EFL Credits may be saved indefinitely or redeemed for available rewards. Spending EFL Credits never reduces Legacy Points or Legacy Rank.
The current reward tiers are 100 EC for +$25 FAAB, 200 EC for a Supplemental Dynasty Rookie Pick, and 400 EC for one Free EFL Dynasty Entry.
A franchise may redeem no more than one Legacy reward per league year.
Ranks are intentionally designed as long-term, multi-season career achievements. Hall of Famer should be exceptionally rare.
Unless a badge explicitly says otherwise, each badge can be unlocked only once per franchise. Repeating the same achievement does not award additional LP or duplicate badges.
Championship history may be displayed as a separate title count, but the EFL Champion achievement badge itself unlocks only once.
Live status badges identify a current holder and do not repeatedly farm Legacy Points.
Commissioner review resolves platform-data errors, reward redemptions and achievements that cannot be verified automatically.

badges.name: Legacy Franchise Owner
badges.requirement: Owned an EFL Dynasty franchise before the start of the 2026 Legacy Era.

badges.name: Legacy Champion
badges.requirement: Won at least one EFL championship before the 2026 Legacy Era. Historical championship totals remain visible separately.

badges.name: EFL Champion
badges.requirement: Win an EFL championship during the Legacy Era.

badges.name: Back-to-Back
badges.requirement: Win Legacy Era championships in consecutive seasons.

badges.name: Three Crown
badges.requirement: Win three Legacy Era EFL championships.

badges.name: Regular Season King
badges.requirement: Finish first in the regular-season standings during the Legacy Era.

badges.name: Points King
badges.requirement: Finish a Legacy Era regular season with the league's most points scored.

badges.name: Untouchable
badges.requirement: Complete a fantasy regular season undefeated.

badges.name: 200 Club
badges.requirement: Score at least 200 fantasy points in a single matchup.

badges.name: Absolute Destruction
badges.requirement: Win a matchup by at least 100 fantasy points.

badges.name: Photo Finish
badges.requirement: Win a matchup by less than 1.00 fantasy point.

badges.name: Hot Streak
badges.requirement: Win five consecutive matchups in one season.

badges.name: Perfect Month
badges.requirement: Go undefeated across four consecutive fantasy weeks.

badges.name: Comeback Kid
badges.requirement: Reach the playoffs after starting a season 0-3 or worse.

badges.name: Giant Killer
badges.requirement: Defeat the current #1 EFL Power Rankings franchise.

badges.name: King of the Hill
badges.requirement: Hold the #1 position in the published EFL Power Rankings.

badges.name: Wire Wizard
badges.requirement: Commissioner-verified elite waiver/free-agent acquisition that materially impacts the season.

badges.name: Playoff Assassin
badges.requirement: Win two playoff matchups in the same championship run.

badges.name: First-Class Ticket
badges.requirement: Earn a top-two regular-season finish and first-round playoff bye.

badges.name: On the Podium
badges.requirement: Finish a season in the EFL top three.

badges.name: Worst to First
badges.requirement: Finish last in one Legacy Era season and win the championship the following season.

badges.name: Iron Franchise
badges.requirement: Complete five consecutive Legacy Era seasons as franchise owner.

badges.name: EFL Lifetimer
badges.requirement: Complete ten Legacy Era seasons as franchise owner.

badges.name: Four Digits
badges.requirement: Accumulate 1,000 regular-season points in an EFL season.

badges.name: Weekly Hammer
badges.requirement: Post the highest score in the league for a fantasy week.

badges.name: Bracket Breaker
badges.requirement: Reach the championship game from a seed of fifth or lower.

badges.name: Consolation King
badges.requirement: Win the EFL consolation bracket and earn pick 2.13.

badges.name: Business Trip
badges.requirement: Earn a first-round bye and advance to the EFL championship game.

badges.name: Title Defense
badges.requirement: Return to the championship game the season after winning the title.

badges.name: Three-Week Terror
badges.requirement: Lead the league in weekly scoring three times in one regular season.

badges.name: Double Crown
badges.requirement: Finish first in regular-season standings and win the EFL championship in the same season.

badges.name: Triple Crown Season
badges.requirement: Lead regular-season standings, lead regular-season points, and win the championship in the same season.

badges.name: Survivor
badges.requirement: Make the playoffs with a .500 or worse regular-season record.

badges.name: Century Club
badges.requirement: Win 100 Legacy Era EFL matchups.
